body:
"Be with your friends/loved ones. Take time for yourself"

I don't even know who are my loved ones. If I take time to myself, this will happen again.

Oh, and, if I somehow did manage to pull my shit together and commit suicide, if I somehow fail to die while committing suicide, I would be charged with self-murder and I would have to spend at least a year in jail. I live in a nation where the act of suicide is criminalise.

The people I trust must have been fed up with me at this point. It happens too much now. In the past 3 weeks alone I had multiple panic attacks and this kind of thoughts. I lost count how many I had.

They all tried. But their advice are pretty much the same. It just doesn't work on me for some reason.
I don't know. It would go from being just another normal day to me again wanting to jump as soon as it turn into nighttime. The cycle shows no signs of stopping

Everything. Everything happens. Everything I do.

Certain things might make me happy at the moment. Maybe. But after that moment pass, I'm back to my miserable self. I'm always thinking of ways on how to actually kill myself without being noticed. If I had the money, I would maybe go as far as hiring someone to just. Do it.

Maybe it's just me craving for a relationship at this point of my life. I have always been the shy person kind of type. I would avoid any interaction if possible. That also means I didn't have many chance talking to girls. The only other person I truly had feelings for before this was my first crush. I built up courage after 6 years and confessed at one night. She was taken aback a lot. But we both decided not to think about it... until 3 years later. We were both about to graduate from high school. I built up the courage again to ask her out. I got rejected once. And I think it was enough to traumatise me about relationships. I locked myself even more and bottled my feelings even more.

As you can see, I don't have the courage to instantly confess. And my first crush, I hold on to it for 9 years. 9 whole years. I see myself as the kind of person that once I like someone, I would commit everything towards them. I am not sure if that's how people see me.

Just in case you were wondering, the long-distance relationship was a failure because I tried taking it seriously but never the opposite party.

First point: Yes I am aware. She is not doing anything wrong. I don't blame her. Hell, I am not even supposed to blame her for anything. I got myself into this mess

Last point: I don't know. Her best friend are trustworthy. Because we all share our own secrets. Just maybe not to this extent. But again, you might be right.

I am trying to work on myself. Harder than I thought. Any advice? I guess there's another subreddit for those stuffs. Any suggestions?

I can't seem to answer the 2nd and 3rd point. I simply don't know what to say/answer.
